newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips boosted by upbeat retail sales.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips boosted by upbeat retail sales.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended higher Thursday, buoyed by upbeat reports on retail sales for January, but the mood on Wall Street was cautious ahead of the release early Friday of the key jobs data for January.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 26.16 points at 6,773.06. In the broader market, advances led declines by a slight margin on active volume of 522 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
